concepts.proposed_markdown: `POST /v1/contract-pricing/rate-cards/archive` permanently disables a rate card for new contracts, removes it from contract-creation workflows, and preserves pricing for existing contracts. The endpoint page does not define whether preservation uses a snapshot or retained reference, how later catalog changes interact with those contracts, visibility outside creation workflows, restoration, propagation timing, in-flight contract creation, idempotency, or concurrency. [[source-metronome-api-reference-rate-cards-archive-a-rate-card]]
warnings: Do not generalize preserved existing pricing into a claim that existing contracts are detached, snapshotted, or immune to every later product or rate change.
Do not equate permanent disablement with deletion or claim that archived rate cards are unavailable from every read surface.
